name: pathfinder-stormhacks
description: Right-click a function to see every call path that leads to it.

pathfinder.explain.provider.description: Which AI "Explain Current Path" uses. Optional feature: set a key with "PathFinder: Set AI API Key".

pathfinder.openGraphOnCrash.description: When the debugger stops because of an exception or crash, open the PathFind graph for the crashing function and highlight how the program got there.

pathfinder.explain.model.description: Model to use instead of the provider's default (claude-opus-5-5, gpt-6.1-sol, gemini-3.8-flash). Leave empty for the default.

commands.title: PathFind: Test Graph with Workspace Paths
PathFinder: Set AI API Key (Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini)

scripts.compile: tsc -p tsconfig.extension.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview.json && npm run build:webview
scripts.test:unit: tsc -p tsconfig.extension.json && node out/test/debugTracker.unit.js && node out/test/recursion.unit.js && node out/test/chokepoints.unit.js && node out/test/callValues.unit.js && node out/test/breakpoints.unit.js && node out/test/sessionHistory.unit.js &&node out/test/targetLayout.unit.js && node out/test/truncationMarkers.unit.js && npm run test:renderer
scripts.test:renderer: tsc -p tsconfig.webview.json && esbuild media/graph.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=out/test/graphRenderer.unit.js && node out/test/graphRenderer.unit.js
